versions.content: PreBuild Disabling PostBuild support It is possible to define a variation point as both PreBuild and PostBuild . If the PreBuild condition is false, it is not expected that the variant object (including the PostBuild condition) will be implemented. In other words, a system constant expression in a variation point may be used to disable the PostBuild variability even at PreBuild time.
